summary: A host- or agent-signed linux-gate note records the base its clippy ratchet was measured against (input clippy_base_sha, required by the policy): st-test gives the stage the base it just fetched; scripts/ci-local run by hand fetches main itself and never trusts a local ref. evidence-wrap gains --input NAME=VALUE.

replay.detail: Earlier host linux-gate notes lack the input and stop counting; none was ever enforced (the check is in shadow).

schema.detail: A new optional observed input, clippy_base_sha, on wrapper notes; required for host and agent linux-gate notes.

rules.detail: A host or agent linux-gate note without clippy_base_sha is refused (missing input).

compatibility.detail: st-test and evidence-wrap come from the base, so both sides change together.

recovery.detail: Drop clippy_base_sha from the required inputs.
